title: LAPD Axon streetlight license plate reader pilot

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the applicable public records law, I request the following records:

https://www.sbsun.com/2026/09/22/lapd-to-test-license-plate-reading-surveillance-cameras-on-some-city-street-lights/

Records concerning the Board of Police Commissioners’ approval and implementation of the three-month Axon license plate reader pilot on city-owned street lights, including the pilot proposal and scope, staff reports, agreements or other governing documents, planned or approved camera locations, installation and operating schedules, and communications between LAPD Chief Information Officer Dean Gialamas and the Board or its staff about the pilot.

September 22, 2026, through the end of the three-month pilot

Please provide responsive records electronically. If any portion is withheld, please release all reasonably segregable portions and cite the legal basis for each withholding.

Thank you.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jason Koebler
